title: Google Trends Scraper Input

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to scrape. 'Interest over time & related queries' is the Google Trends Explore view (keywords required). 'Trending now' lists what is spiking in a country right now.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: One or more search terms to analyze (mode=interest). Each term becomes its own dataset row, or enable Comparison mode to compare up to 5 terms side by side. Example: `tesla` or `tesla, ford, toyota`.

compareMode.title: Comparison mode
compareMode.description: Compare all search terms on one shared 0-100 scale in a single row (Google Trends comparison view, maximum 5 terms). Off means each term is scraped independently.

startUrls.title: Trends URLs (optional)
startUrls.description: Paste Google Trends links to scrape them directly: explore links (trends.google.com/trends/explore?q=..., including www.google.com/trends/... redirect links) and embedded-chart links (trends.google.com/trends/embed/explore/...?req=...). Trending Now links (trends.google.com/trending?geo=...) are supported too. URL settings override the fields above; they are merged with your search terms.

url.title: URL
url.description: Google Trends explore or Trending Now URL.

geo.title: Location
geo.description: Country, state/region or metro area to analyze. Leave empty for worldwide. Trending Now uses the country part of this location.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: Which Google surface to query (mode=interest). Web Search is the default.

geoResolution.title: Geographic resolution (optional)
geoResolution.description: Breakdown level for 'interest by region' (mode=interest). Auto lets Google pick the right level for the location; other levels are applied when the location supports them.

trendingHours.title: Trending time window (mode=trending)
trendingHours.description: How far back the Trending Now list goes (mode=trending).

trendingCategory.title: Trending category (mode=trending)
trendingCategory.description: Filter the Trending Now list to one of Google's trending categories (mode=trending).

includeTrendingNews.title: Attach trending news (mode=trending)
includeTrendingNews.description: Attach news headlines, links and sources from Google's Trending RSS feed to trending items whose titles it covers (about ten highlighted stories per country, anywhere in the list).

maxItems.title: Maximum records
maxItems.description: Maximum dataset records per run: each interest row counts as one record, each trending item as one record. Remaining work stops once the limit is reached.

description: Scrape Google Trends: interest over time, interest by region, related queries and Trending Now — any keyword, location, time range and Google surface.
